title: Espressif Hardware Design Guidelines
reviewed_sections: docs/en/pcb-layout-design.rst: General Principles, Crystal, RF (conditional source; target-specific includes not fully reviewed)
limitations: Read selected source sections, not all per-chip includes or figures. Must resolve IDF_TARGET conditions and consult rendered guide for the actual chip; no measurement performed.

title: OLIMEX ESP32-PoE open hardware, revision M2
reviewed_sections: HARDWARE/Revision-changes.txt: H1, I, M, M1, M2
limitations: Revision notes are maintainer-reported field experience, not a controlled experiment. PCB and schematic downloaded; only selected PCB metadata inspected, not a full electrical/layout review. Stackup in project file is not certified as manufactured.
evidence: Revision I records changing 2 to 4 layers for DCDC cooling; H1 records Ethernet loss when external load draws current and circuit changes. M2 file contains four copper layers and a declared stackup. No thermal/EMC raw test data found in reviewed files.
license: Hardware Apache-2.0, software GPL3, documentation CC-BY-SA-3.0 per README; inspect individual files before reuse.

title: KiCad DRC providers: track width and differential pair coupling
limitations: Static reading of selected source only; no KiCad build or live DRC run. Geometric checks do not establish impedance, thermal or EMC compliance.
evidence: Track width Run explicitly skips checks if no TRACK_WIDTH_CONSTRAINT; checks actual segments/arcs against per-layer resolved limits. Differential-pair provider uses gap and maximum-uncoupled constraints.
license: Project distribution GPL-3.0-or-later with listed exceptions; read track-width file header GPL-2.0-or-later. No upstream code copied into this repository.
